reason: 一次資料の要旨・本文が示す対象はLLM推論システムの計算量、メモリ、レイテンシ、スループット、KV cache、量子化、offload、servingの改善と技術的につながらない。This work analyzes stragglers in LLM training using a five-month cluster trace and what-if simulation. Findings concern training-stage imbalance, sequence-length imbalance, memory fragmentation and launch delays; it does not address inference systems.
title: Understanding Stragglers in Large Model Training Using What-if Analysis
